info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Jobs-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Job Listing API enables users to access a comprehensive list of job openings available for applications. This API serves as a resource for job seekers to explore opportunities, retrieve relevant job details, and enhance their application process. Typical consumers include recruitment platforms, HR applications, and career web portals. By utilizing this API, organizations can efficiently integrate job listings and streamline the hiring process.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint fetches all job applications currently available in the system. It allows developers to integrate job application data into their applications, providing a seamless experience for managing job opportunities.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving job applications. This body contains the necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the details of the job applications that are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of job applications.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on applications and jobs.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.title: Job Response

status.description: Indicates whether the job application status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the job application.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the job application processing.

state.description: Current state of the job application.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the job application in milliseconds.

message.description: Message containing additional information about the job application status.

ListCareersApplicationsJobsResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for a successful job retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the job application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the job application was created.

automated.description: Flag indicating whether the job application was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit details related to the job application.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds. This value indicates the duration of the operation on the server side.
